clipboard.copy_paste.scope: selected GUI content and intended destination; not a terminal
clipboard.copy_paste.steps: Select the source; copy; navigate to and focus the intended destination; paste.

clipboard.move_paste.scope: movable selected GUI content and intended destination; not a terminal
clipboard.move_paste.steps: Select the movable source; cut; navigate to and focus the intended destination; paste.

clipboard.transfer.scope: selected GUI content and intended destination; not a terminal
clipboard.transfer.steps: Choose copy to retain the source or cut to move it; never perform both. Focus the intended destination, then paste.

files.transfer.scope: GNOME Files or compatible file pane; verify focus
files.transfer.steps: Select source files. Choose copy to retain them or cut to move them; never perform both. Navigate to the destination folder, then paste.

clipboard.copy.scope: selected GUI content; not a terminal
clipboard.copy.steps: With the intended GUI content selected, copy the selection.

clipboard.cut.scope: selected movable GUI content; not a terminal
clipboard.cut.steps: With the intended movable GUI content selected, cut the selection.

clipboard.paste.scope: intended destination field or file pane; not a terminal
clipboard.paste.steps: Focus the intended destination field or file pane, then paste the clipboard once.

files.copy.scope: GNOME Files or compatible file pane; verify focus
files.copy.steps: Select source files; copy; navigate to the destination folder; paste.

files.move.scope: GNOME Files or compatible file pane; verify focus
files.move.steps: Select source files; cut; navigate to the destination folder; paste.

files.rename.scope: selected file in GNOME Files or compatible file pane
files.rename.steps: Open rename for the selected file; replace the requested basename or extension; enter the requested name; confirm.

text.edit.scope: focused editable text field; not a canvas or terminal
text.edit.steps: Focus the editable field; use Select All only for a full-field replacement, then type the user-provided value.

text.replace_confirm.scope: editable field in a dialog with a verified Enter-to-confirm action
text.replace_confirm.steps: Focus the editable field; use Select All only for a full-field replacement; type the value; confirm.

text.confirm.scope: focused dialog control with a known confirm action
text.confirm.steps: Use Enter on the focused dialog control whose confirm action is known.

ui.dismiss.steps: Use Escape once on the active dismissible popup.

history.undo.steps: Undo one edit in the focused editable content window.

document.find.scope: content window whose menu supports Find
document.find.steps: Open Find in the content window; type the desired query in the search field.

document.open.scope: content window whose File menu supports Open
document.open.steps: Open the file dialog; choose the intended file; confirm.

document.save.scope: editable document whose File menu supports Save
document.save.steps: Save the current editable document; supply a name and location if the application opens a dialog. Use Export for format export.

navigation.down.steps: Use PageDown in the focused scrollable content pane to advance one viewport.

navigation.up.steps: Use PageUp in the focused scrollable content pane to go back one viewport.

vlc.capture.scope: VLC 3.x Linux player; verify menu binding, not a text field
vlc.capture.steps: Use Video > Take Snapshot or Shift+S in the VLC player.

gimp.export.scope: GIMP image window; documented for 2.10, verify current menu binding
gimp.export.steps: Use File > Export As or Ctrl+Shift+E; choose format, name and location; set the format options; confirm export.

navigation.horizontal.scope: content pane with a visible horizontal scrollbar or supported horizontal scrolling
navigation.horizontal.steps: Use the focused pane's visible horizontal scrollbar in the requested left/right direction.

view.zoom_value.scope: an exact zoom ratio is required and the editable zoom field is confirmed
view.zoom_value.steps: For a required precise ratio, focus the editable zoom field; select its text; type the required value; confirm once. Do not re-enter an already submitted value.

view.zoom_confirm.scope: a zoom value was entered; verify the zoom field is still focused
view.zoom_confirm.steps: If the zoom value has been entered and the field is still focused, confirm once with Enter. Do not select or type again.

menu.open.steps: Open the named enabled menu visible in the current application.

window.maximize.scope: GNOME active window; verify it is not already maximized
window.maximize.steps: Use Alt+F10 once on the active GNOME window. This toggles maximization; a second use restores the previous size.

view.zoom_in.scope: confirmed visible Zoom In control; relative increase is needed
view.zoom_in.steps: Use the visible Zoom In command once for a relative increase.

view.zoom_out.scope: confirmed visible Zoom Out control; relative decrease is needed
view.zoom_out.steps: Use the visible Zoom Out command once for a relative decrease.

window.locate.scope: a named application/window or desktop overview; focus unconfirmed
window.locate.steps: Select the requested application window in the visible desktop or window switcher.

folder.open.scope: visible file manager, folder pane or location control
folder.open.steps: Open the intended folder in the file manager, or enter its path in the visible location control.

url.open.steps: Enter the requested URL in the browser address control and navigate.

files.find.scope: file manager or file chooser with a visible file-search control
files.find.steps: Enter the named file or folder in the visible file-search control.

document.save_as.scope: editable content whose File menu explicitly supports Save As; not Export
document.save_as.steps: Use Save As; choose name, location and format; confirm. Save As and Export are distinct commands.
